name: Lilinum, the Devastating One (Deflect 2)

features.Instinctive Aggression: It costs Lilinum no focus to use the Reactive Strike reaction.
features.Shroud of Dust: When an enemy makes a ranged attack or other test against Lilinum from at least 25 feet away, if that test relies on sight or smell, it gains disadvantage.

action.name: Strike: Claws
action.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 2 (1d4) keen damage and 3 (1d6) spirit damage. Hit: 9 (1d4 + 7) keen damage and 3 (1d6) spirit damage.

action.name: Strike: Shardblade
action.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 8 (2d8) spirit damage. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 7) spirit damage.

bi_action.name: Devastating Touch
bi_action.description: Attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 10 (3d6) spirit damage. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) spirit damage.

bi_action.name: Surge of Division
bi_action.description: Costs 2 Investiture. Lilinum chooses a Large object within 30 ft that isn't worn/held, destroying it. Effects can include obscuring the area with dust, opening passage, triggering rockslide, or electrifying. Affected characters must make DC 15 Agility or Athletics test. On failure, 13 (3d8) damage; on success, no damage/no effect.

reaction.name: Reactive Strike
reaction.description: Instinctive Aggression makes this cost 0 focus.

reaction.name: Demolish Weapon
reaction.description: After she is hit or grzed by a non-invested weapon, she can turn that weapon to dust.

free.name: Regenerate
free.description: Costs 1 Investiture. Lilinum recovers 5 (1d6+2) health. Can use even while Unconscious or otherwise prevented from actions.

tactics: Lilinum fights with playful recklessness, using Shardblade and Devastating Touch, then Claws. She uses Surge of Division to collapse structures and Regenerate as needed.
